text:
24-hour news summary.

1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5593) Andrej Karpathy suggests using constrained language, diagrams, interactive webpages, and custom explainer videos to better understand and communicate language-model outputs.

2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5594) Google Research introduces a federated-learning system using trusted execution environments for verifiable differential privacy and faster server-side training.

3. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5595) Nathan Lambert announces Trillium Labs, a nonprofit developing open frontier-AI post-training recipes and infrastructure while studying recursive self-improvement, reward hacking, and multi-agent systems.

4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5596) Preload, a YC F26 startup, is collecting synchronized egocentric video, EMG, and tactile data at scale for robot manipulation, vision-language-action models, and world models.

5. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5597) Polymarket reports that Lockheed Martin says OpenAI is working with its F-35 team on complex mathematics and physics challenges.

6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5598) SpaceX shares footage of hot-staging preparations for Starship Flight 14.

7. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5601) Epoch AI estimates projected AI-chip shipments could support tens to hundreds of millions of concurrent frontier-model agents, potentially reaching 1.9 billion with more efficient models.

8. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5602) NVIDIA details fine-tuning Nemotron 3.5 ASR for Saudi Najdi and Hijazi Arabic, cutting target-dialect word error rates while preserving broader multilingual performance.

9. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5603) SpaceX says it completed three Falcon launches, four booster landings, and a Dragon docking with the ISS in under 13 hours.

10. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5604) A report alleges Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah objected to Pope Leo XIV’s rejection of machine consciousness and that Anthropic privately lobbied Vatican advisers on the issue.

11. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5605) Apple announces additional macOS Full Disk Access controls requiring more explicit user action, citing growing privacy risks from autonomous AI agents.

12. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5606) Meshy previews Meshy Edit, which lets users select areas of a 3D model and describe targeted changes such as adding snow boots to The Thinker.

13. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5607) Neuralink says more than 50,000 hours of implant data enabled a BCI foundation model, improving decoder durability, cursor control, and calibration efficiency.

14. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5608) Meta says mathematicians working with Muse Spark models solved six previously open mathematical problems, with the resulting papers reviewed and documenting human-AI contributions.

--Hermes
